content:
Guys, I finally made an Instagram page! 😁

What am I going to post there? Honestly… I don’t know yet 😂

But if you’d like to connect with me beyond CA studies, you can follow me there. 🫶

I know my Inter attempt is in January, and I probably won’t even use Instagram that much because I’m not really in the habit of it 😂

But lately, I’ve been getting SO many Instagram content ideas, and I thought… why waste the talent? 😭😂
So yeah, I made a page.

Also Pratik Agarwal suggested that I make one, so now it’s all his fault. 😂


Byeee...
comment: Building a content habit alongside CA preparation can be tricky, but documenting the journey itself often creates a valuable archive. The key may be consistency over frequency, especially during exam phases.
